items.title: ‘We Have to Overcome Big Challenges,’ McKinstry Says as He Names Scorpions Squad for AFCON Qualifiers
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe Scorpions head coach Johnathan McKinstry has named a 25-man squad for The Gambia’s opening Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers against Somalia and Ghana, saying the team must be prepared to overcome significant challenges if it is to secure a place at next year’s to...
